issues.where: the red mud foreground around the standing animal's feet and the lower-left ground
issues.what: the mud is a faceted low-poly mesh with stretched, smeared texture; it reads as CG terrain at playing speed
issues.fix: raise mesh density and displacement, use a proper wet-mud material with fine detail and specular wetness

issues.where: the brine pools and the salt crust plates centre-right and lower-right
issues.what: the crust plates are flat slabs with hard extruded edges like cut cards, and the ground under the animal is a faceted mesh with blurred stretched texture
issues.fix: give the crust irregular broken edges, thickness variation and crystal growth; replace faceted ground with displaced wet sediment

issues.where: right crop, salt crust beside the standing animal's foot (x 83-100%, y 58-75%)
issues.what: stair-step aliasing / terraced steps along the crust edge and a smeared, stretched crust texture
issues.fix: fix the displacement resolution and UV stretching on the crust edge

issues.where: bottom-right crop, mud around the claws (x 0-17%, y 58-75%)
issues.what: triangular facets and a visible hard-edged polygon plane of white crust over the mud; claws sit on the surface with no displacement, wet ring or mud on them
issues.fix: subdivide the terrain, let the claws sink and pick up mud

issues.where: bottom-right crop (x 0-17%, y 58-75%) and bottom-left crust mound
issues.what: crust slab edge is a thin sheet with small spike triangles poking up; the salt mound texture is streaked and smeared like a stretched projection
issues.fix: model the crust edge with thickness and crystal fringe, re-project the mound texture

issues.where: both crops at the animal's base and the right-hand ground
issues.what: the ground is jagged faceted mesh with blurry, stretched texture; a rectangular flat patch shows on the right; the animal shows no mud contact line or wetness
issues.fix: higher-res displaced terrain, remove the flat patch, add contact mud and wet darkening on the animal

issues.what: the animals have a smooth uniform model look with the same skin texture everywhere and nothing of the place on them: no mud, salt crust or wet sheen on the legs and bellies standing in red brine
issues.fix: add mud and salt buildup, wet darkening up the legs and belly, and varied skin detail

issues.what: the brine is a flat red tint with little depth, almost no reflection of the bright sky and no wet edge or foam where it meets the white crust
issues.fix: add sky reflection, depth darkening, a wet margin and crust froth at the shoreline

issues.what: the haze is a fairly even flat white tint over the horizon with no structure
issues.fix: give the mist density variation and drifting structure

issues.where: the tree trunks in the left crop of set-B-02
issues.what: the trunk bark texture repeats evenly along the trunk
issues.fix: break the repeat with variation along the trunk
